pages.text: From tier 2 on, machines run on $(bold)FE$(), so generators from other mods work too.$(br2)Cables carry power from generators to machines and share it out evenly. Each tier has a faster cable and a bigger battery. Cables of different tiers never join.
Batteries store power between generators and machines. Their faces follow the side configuration: power goes in through Input faces and out of Output faces.
